punchline: The same criticism landed differently when it came with high standards and a stated belief the student could meet them.
thirty_sec: In a 1999 study, Cohen, Steele and Ross gave Black and White students the same critical essay feedback in different wrappers; criticism paired with high standards plus assurance removed the gap in perceived bias that bare criticism produced.
question: Whose work will you comment on next, and how will you show them the standard and your belief they can meet it?
key_contrast: Criticism answers a question about the work; assurance answers the one about the person.
